description: Ten minutes of a quiet LAN: ten hosts and the gateway resolve each other (broadcast requests, replies, unicast refresh requests), and 10.1.1.20 boots at 5 minutes with three RFC 5227 probes from 0.0.0.0 and a two-packet gratuitous announcement. No arp_spoof kind fires: every reply answers a request and the announcement is within the two free gratuitous ARPs.
